question: Why does the same message cost more, and fit less, when written to a chatbot in some languages?
answer: Because its word-pieces were learned mostly from English. The tokeniser, which chops text into the chunks a model reads, gives common English words one piece but splits rarer scripts into many. A 2023 study found the same text could take up to 15 times as many pieces. They pay more per sentence.
move: A tool shaped by its commonest users charges everyone else a hidden tax.
reference: Petrov, La Malfa, Torr & Bibi, Language Model Tokenizers Introduce Unfairness Between Languages, NeurIPS, 2023
